question_text: Describe how a controller could poll several water-level sensors rather than waiting for interrupts.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A program periodically checks each sensor in turn, reads its status/value, then repeats after a suitable interval. Polling frequency sets how quickly a change can be detected.

marking_points.criterion: Relates readings/change detection to monitored water levels.
